short.text: C.J. Mosley is a veteran NFL interior reserve who came into Jacksonville's line rotation late in 2013, dressing for {{2013.regular.games:words}} regular-season games and {{2013.playoffs.games:words}} playoff games. He brings strength to the middle of the line and can occupy a block and hold a limited run assignment. He is more useful holding a block than creating repeated penetration, and his get-off and pass-rush counters are his main weaknesses.

transactions.text: Signed a three-year contract with Jacksonville
